mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_item_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, unit_price, amount, line_total, created_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), #{orderId}, p.product_id, p.name, p.image, p.price, ci.amount, p.price * ci.amount, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM cart_items ci JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ci.product_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId}
mapper.select: SELECT order_item_id, order_id, product_id, product_name, product_image, unit_price, amount, line_total, created_at FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
